AppUpdate.VersionNotes: - The progress bar along the bottom of a sound can be **clicked or dragged** to move a playing or paused sound to that point in the track. It thickens under the mouse to show it will take a click. (A stopped sound has no place to move; a click on its bar is a click on the sound, which plays it.) - **Clicking a sound while it plays pauses it, and clicking again resumes it** from where it was. A click used to start the sound over from the beginning, throwing away its place; that is now only what **stop** followed by **play** does. Hotkeys still retrigger the sound as before.
